info.name: Autonomous Content-to-Action Agent — Backend
info.description: Postman Collection v2.1.0 for the Autonomous Content-to-Action Agent backend. Mirrors backend/src/docs/openapi.ts (Phase 5 OpenAPI 3.0 spec). All requests resolve {{baseUrl}} from the collection variables; pipeline-scoped requests resolve their `:id` path variable from {{active_pipeline_id}}, and the contract lookup resolves `:name` from {{contract_name}} — flip these once at the collection level to retarget every dependent endpoint.

variable.description: Root for every request URL. Override per environment if running against staging.
Default pipeline_id (matches ^PIPE-[A-Z0-9]{8}$) — wired into the `:id` path variable on all four pipeline-scoped requests.
Default contract slug — wired into the `:name` path variable on GET /api/contracts/:name.

item.name: System Metrics
item.description: Liveness + environment probe used by judges and CI smoke tests.

request.description: Liveness + environment + loaded contracts. Returns { status, environment, provider, contracts_loaded[], timestamp }.

item.name: Ingestion Pipeline
item.description: Entrypoint for the multi-source ingestion → orchestration pipeline.

request.description: Submit a multi-source pipeline run. The sample body carries one URL source and one text source matching the MultiSourceIngestionSource schema. Returns { pipeline_id, status, sources_received, constraints_received }.

item.name: Telemetry & Tracing
item.description: Read the full PipelineTrace (events, reasoning steps, tool calls, action execution) for a given pipeline_id.

request.description: Full pipeline trace. 404 if the pipeline_id is unknown.
Antigravity trace export (judge-facing alias). Same shape as GET /api/pipeline/:id.

item.name: Contract Enforcement
item.description: Browse loaded YAML contracts (registry summaries + full definitions) and inspect contract_gate validation events.

request.description: List all loaded YAML contracts (summary view: name, version, module, description, field_count).

variable.description: Contract slug, e.g. action_chain_v1 or workflow_audit_v1.

request.description: Full contract definition by name. 404 if the contract slug is not registered.
All contract_gate events grouped by pipeline_id — cross-pipeline contract-violation analytics.

item.name: Human-In-The-Loop Execution
item.description: HITL approval gate. State machine: PENDING → EXECUTING → COMPLETED|REJECTED. Only PENDING → EXECUTING is reachable through POST /approve (atomic check-and-set; concurrent approvals get 409).

request.description: Inspect a pipeline blocked at the HITL approval gate. 200 returns the full PipelineApprovalRecord; 404 if unknown; 409 if the pipeline has already left PENDING state.

Approve a PENDING pipeline (atomic PENDING → EXECUTING). 400 if approved_by is missing/empty; 404 if the pipeline_id is unknown; 409 if the pipeline is not in PENDING state (e.g. already EXECUTING due to a prior approve, or REJECTED/COMPLETED).
